intent: An in-product plan comparison for upgrades, not a marketing page: a Monthly / Yearly switch, one card per plan with price, features and one CTA. Recommended and current are words; the recommended plan's CTA is the one solid primary. Built on kit SegmentedControl, Badge, Button and NumberTransition.
useWhen: upgrade or change plan inside the product
compare a few plans side by side with their features
doNotUseWhen: usage against a plan limit — UsageMeter
picking options in a form — TileGroup

plans.note: { id, name, tagline?, price, yearlyPrice?, features, ctaLabel?, recommended?, current? }[]

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h3 title; each plan name is an h4
the interval is a kit SegmentedControl radio group
Recommended and Current plan are Badge words, not colour alone
prices roll with NumberTransition and have a full spoken label
each CTA is described by its plan name; the current plan's CTA is disabled

doNot: Do not invent a local PlanCard or PricingTable
Do not show more than one solid primary; current plan is never solid
Do not mark the recommended plan by border colour alone
snippet: <PricingPlans plans={plans} interval={interval} onIntervalChange={setInterval} onSelect={choose} savingsLabel="Save 17% with yearly" footnote="Prices exclude tax. Change or cancel any time." />
